class.name: DisAcknowledgePdu
class.brief_description: Acknowledge PDU (type 15): the answer to a Simulation Management request.
class.description: An Acknowledge PDU answers a [DisCreateEntityPdu], [DisRemoveEntityPdu], [DisStartResumePdu] or [DisStopFreezePdu]. [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id] repeats the request's ID, [member acknowledge_flag] says which kind of request is answered and [member response_flag] says whether the receiver can comply. It is 32 bytes long.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Acknowledge PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Acknowledge PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 32 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].

members.member: Which kind of request this answers (16-bit): one of the [enum AcknowledgeFlag] values or another SISO-REF-010 "Acknowledge Flag" code.
How the receiver responds (16-bit): one of the [enum ResponseFlag] values or another SISO-REF-010 "Response Flag" code.

constants.constant: Acknowledge flag 1: answers a Create Entity PDU.
Acknowledge flag 2: answers a Remove Entity PDU.
Acknowledge flag 3: answers a Start/Resume PDU.
Acknowledge flag 4: answers a Stop/Freeze PDU.
Acknowledge flag 5: answers a Transfer Ownership request.
Response flag 1: the receiver is able to comply.
Response flag 2: the receiver is unable to comply.
Response flag 3: waiting for an operator to act.
Response flag 4: the receiver needs more information.
